text: ポケモンの　しんか　けいたいも　はいって　きとる…　すばらしい！

structure.jp: ポケモンの　しんか　けいたいも

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: くる after a て-form verb says something has been coming along bit by bit up to now. はいって　きとる = 'have been coming in'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: とる is an old-man, western-dialect way of saying ている, which shows something is going on now. きとる = きている = 'is coming along'.
